item.text:
The fault is in [internal/server/audit/types.go](/app/internal/server/audit/types.go:134). Audit `Rule` lacks `SegmentOperator`, and audit `RolloutSegment` lacks `Operator`. `NewRule` and `NewRollout` copy only the legacy `SegmentKey`, so they lose the `SegmentKeys` and `SegmentOperator` data already present in the source types.

The fix should add the requested JSON tagged fields, preserve single segment keys and rollout values, and join multiple keys with commas while recording the operator’s enum name. Existing audit tests cover only the legacy rule key; they do not establish the expected output for multiple segments. I recorded the diagnosis in `.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md`. Project source and tests were left untouched because my assigned fault localization role prohibits modifying them.
